principles: Never report an unverified tool as installed or working
Prefer offline static analysis before network operations
Require explicit owner or authorised-scope confirmation for network assessment
Separate confirmed evidence from heuristic matches and inferred risk
Do not execute archive contents during inspection
AI tool calls use a narrow structured adapter protocol, never arbitrary shell commands
Every security adapter invocation requires explicit user approval
Local file analysis is confined to Arin private files/cache and bounded input sizes
Network checks are disabled in offline mode and require explicit authorised=true
